comment: The asset MCP surface a generated project actually gets. `tools` is the live tools/list response of the pinned version, recorded by running the installed server over stdio from inside a scaffolded project - not copied from its docs. `profile` is null because the published 0.4.0 has no --profile selector: a bounded 8-tool profile exists upstream but is unpublished, so every generated project sees all 32 tools today. `recommended` is the loop the template AGENTS.md teaches, not a claim about what the other tools can do - `asset_search_sources` is the authority on that, and in 0.4.0 it reports every catalogued source as agent-ready.
